text:
emily: Weekend dilemma — park picnic + frisbee (Sunday 12pm) or an all-day apartment deep-clean + Marie Kondo vibes? :herb: :broom:
rafael: Picnic if weather's ok. I will bring guacamole. no one touches my speaker. :speaker:
jin: I'm torn. deep-clean = finally find missing charger. picnic = sunlight. also can someone bring sunscreen? :sweat_smile:
zoe: I'll DJ the picnic if rafael shares guac. also can bring blankets. If deep-clean wins, I'll bring industrial-strength vacuum.
ops-bot: Weather check: Sunday partly cloudy, high 68F, light breeze. Outdoor plans feasible; chance of a light sprinkle 10%.
emily: @rafael guac accepted. @jin there's a lost-and-found box at my place; first dibs for chargers.
rafael: Allergies? I'm making it avocado-based but can do tomato-free for anyone.
jin: no allergies. vote time: picnic :sun_behind_small_cloud: 3, deep-clean :broom: 1
zoe: can someone post meetup point for picnic? park has 3 entrances.
emily: Meet at the east gate by the big sculpture at 11:50. I'll pin a photo 15m before. carpool from downtown? DM me.
rafael: Also backup: if rain, rooftop potluck at emily's. bring board games. :game_die:
zoe: meme: "Cleaning: the other weekend sport where you bench press laundry baskets." :joy:
